prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of thick masonry walls seen from above: large cut grey stone blocks capping the wall, mortar lines. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square seamless tileable pixel-art texture for a top-down JRPG map: ONLY the top horizontal surface of thick masonry wall, filling the entire canvas edge-to-edge with large fitted cut gray stone cap blocks and dark mortar seams. Orthographic straight overhead view, no visible wall sides, no perspective. Premium modern hi-bit JRPG pixel art. Strict coherent uniform square pixel grid: each art pixel rendered as a crisp same-sized square approximately 7–8 screen pixels wide; hard pixelated edges only, no subpixel shapes or antialiasing, no blur, noise, stippling, checkerboard dithering, photo texture, or soft brushes. Deliberate contiguous clusters of 3–10 art pixels forming worn chipped edges and understated stone grain. Each stone has a restricted 4–6 color earthy gray palette; warm yellow-gray highlights upper left, cooler saturated purple/red-gray shadow tones around recesses and seams. Varied large rectangular stone blocks laid in offset rows with mortar lines, restrained hand-placed chips and worn surfaces, evenly distributed detail and no focal feature. Neutral soft even overcast lighting, clean base colors, no cast shadows, no dramatic lighting, no vignette. CRITICAL: seamless perfectly repeating tile in both axes: mortar lines, stone silhouettes, and colors at the left edge must continue exactly on right edge; top edge exactly continues on bottom edge. No border, frame, characters, props, text, or empty space.
